purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 106 hypothesis 1 after preserving and auditing the untouched v91 baseline failure.
change_scope: One generic path-recovery change: exact-basename candidates are ranked by the count of consecutive case-insensitive path components matching from the basename upward. A singular candidate is exposed only when it is the only candidate or has a unique parent-or-deeper suffix match. Every candidate remains visible and the model must explicitly choose and retry.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The untouched v91 baseline requested /home/user/TETRIS/main.py. Exact-basename recovery returned both /home/user/server/main.py and /home/user/Desktop/tetris/main.py, but the singular candidate was null. Qwen ignored both retry options and repeated the nonexistent path until the eight-event no-progress window stopped it after 36.442 Agent seconds. Evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: A structurally different reporting/assemble.py test creates candidates under Desktop/reporting and server. It proves the unique case-insensitive parent match ranks first and is exposed without executing a retry; the existing equal-score transform.py test proves ambiguous candidates still have no singular preference.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The Adapter compares only path components already present in the model's requested path and discovered exact-basename candidates. It does not read candidate contents, consult task identity or instruction text, hide alternatives, rewrite the model request, select an action, or execute a retry.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; no action or schema was added
implementation_evidence.ruff: all active source, scripts, and tests passed lint; changed files passed format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan and canonical links
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this hypothesis-1 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. At most two additional materially different generic hypotheses remain before marking Order 106 task_blocked and advancing.

selection.method: targeted A/B for the current first non-pass ledger task
